text_block_list.text:
Vodka came by the training room,
perhaps having some business to attend to.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Listen to this, Trainer.
I've only had 4 hours of sleep since yesterday, man!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I was working on my brawn and stuff,
and before I knew it, it was already this late.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: "Well, it might be tough for anyone else, but four hours of sleep is plenty for me..."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
――Gah!
I-It's not like I was sleepy just now or anything!

Just so she could brag about not sleeping,
Vodka ended up staying up late again and again
after that...
